entities.name: Fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase class 1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A4SM33 from Aeromonas salmonicida; 344 aa query, 100% identity and coverage.
Curated enzyme annotation EC 3.1.3.11; catalyzes beta-D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate + H2O = beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + phosphate (Rhea RHEA:11064).
Reviewed reference annotation reports two Mg2+ ions bound per subunit and cytoplasmic localization; pathway includes gluconeogenesis.
